ThinkByte: Harsha Thota, Charan Kumar
Hospicepalliativereview: Rohit, Zwagner
Key Takeaways
Implement Stripe as an external payment system to enhance the ecommerce experience.
Develop enhanced ecommerce tracking with user consent to monitor relevant conversion events.
Redesign the mobile interface to increase purchase button visibility and fix obstruction by the "Let's connect" button.
Simplify the buying process by reducing form fields in the purchase funnel.
Analyze the impact of using a lead magnet on conversion rates.
Use a CDN and compress videos to improve website load times.
Streamline the sales funnel and prioritize primary content to boost user engagement and conversion rates.
Commit to resolving mobile usability issues and enhancing site performance to reduce user drop-offs.
Action Items
You
Compile a list of action items with priority order by tomorrow.
Connect with Harsha this week after returning to Bangalore.
Share the cleaned-up spreadsheet with Zwagner.
Discuss priorities with Harsha on optimizing ad copies, ad spend, and improving website speed.
Coordinate the weekly call schedule with Sharon via WhatsApp.
Message Rohit on WhatsApp to schedule a meeting.
Use Case
Discussed adding promotions, prices, and information to a structure for user convenience.
Technical Challenges
Conversions from quizzes are tracked solely through form submissions
Impact
Compare conversion rates with and without using the lead magnet
Cluster keywords by intent and create relevant ad copies to improve quality score
Proposed Solutions
Implement an external payment system like stripe
Shorten purchase funnel to decrease user drop-offs
Create custom landing pages tailored to specific keyword clusters
Use dynamic content and URL parameters on landing pages for personalized user experiences
Simplify mobile user experience to a one-click funnel
Optimize new copy for gathering more data on user interactions and conversion trends
Utilize video compression and CDN for faster load speeds
Replace videos with static images on mobile for quicker load times
Enhance site visual hierarchy
Will fix the mobile view issue where the "Let's connect" button covers the purchase button.
Test quiz placement to optimize user engagement
Standardize tracking events and create detailed funnels for monitoring user actions
Focus on cleaner tracking and a dashboard to monitor relevant conversion metrics
Business Goals
Consider call ads after optimizing other aspects
Capture and reach out to leads who drop off at the end of the funnel
Identify target audience based on certain emails and find more people similar to them
Clean up tracking and create a clear dashboard for relevant conversion events
Track conversions from the quiz to determine routes
Focus on the digital aspect and not worry about ecommerce
Zwagner expressed interest in further exploring enhanced tracking
Define event hierarchy and strategy for effective tracking
Optimize ad copies and ad spend, improve website speed, and create a dashboard to track key metrics
Decision Maker
Simplify the purchase funnel and reduce the number of fields for better user experience
Features Interested
Integrate own payment system outside of Proprofs and use Stripe
Customize thank you and success pages on the platform
Use Stripe for transactions and connect to learning management system
Rohit inquired about enhanced ecommerce tracking
Pain Points
Automate processes to avoid manual steps
Shorten the funnel to reduce drop-offs and find a more efficient way forward
Noted that the AI interface was making the secondary call-to-action, "Let's connect," appear as the primary call-to-action on mobile, covering the purchase button.
Pricing
Balance cost and relevance in ad campaigns
Gather data and understand user behavior before optimizing for money
